section_summary.extract_value: This procedure section describes a single university-approved daily diary study conducted with female undergraduate psychology students recruited via the university research participant pool. Data were collected online via Qualtrics each evening over an 8-day period (daily emails at 4:00 pm with a 4:00–11:00 pm completion window); participants were instructed to complete at least seven of the eight surveys. The section does not label the study as 'Study 1' or mention multiple sample subsets.
section_summary.evidence_source: Full section text (Procedure): 'The study was advertised through the university's research participant pool to all female undergraduate students enrolled in psychology courses...The study was completed over an 8-day period by each participant. Each day at 4:00 pm participants were emailed a link to complete the survey online via Qualtrics...Participants were instructed to complete at least seven out of the eight surveys that they were sent.'
